text: Degrees and certificates The students who complete degree courses and pass the thesis defenses can obtain graduate certificates of Master degree of Jiamusi University and awarded master’s degree in medicine. Fee Structure 1. Tuition fees: Master’s degree in medicine: 35, 000 RMB/academic year; 18, 000 RMB/semester 2. Lodging fees: 40 RMB/room/day; 12000 RMB/room/ academic year (Single or Double) 3. Register fees: 400 RMB/ academic year 4. Insurance fees: 600 RMB/academic year; 300 RMB/semester 5. Other fees such as Resident permit, teaching material and etc will be paid according to the actual situation.
